title: Anthropic says it cut Claude reasoning token theft by up to 99% in fight against industrial-scale distillation
summary_raw: Anthropic says it has cut the extraction of Claude's internal reasoning tokens by 90 to 99 percent. The company links the large-scale distillation attacks to Chinese companies Zhipu and Moonshot, and has already banned tens of thousands of accounts. title: Anthropic study warns that small AI models could soon replicate across everyday devices
summary_raw: Small AI models may be just months away from spreading on their own across poorly secured consumer devices like smart TVs and robot vacuums, according to a new Anthropic study. In tests, one model already completed the full infection chain. CEO Dario Amodei has warned that a swarm like this could take over the entire internet with a persistent botnet within 6 to 12 months, causing hundreds of billions of dollars in damage. title: Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots
summary_raw: Sakana AI's MASS method lets one language model improve itself by solving tasks, judging results, and refining workflows, reaching a win rate of nearly 70 percent against the base model after two rounds. But when the model misses the same errors across all three roles, it can mistake them for progress and reinforce them during training. title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
summary_raw: Microsoft researchers found that autonomous AI agents get trapped in what they call "idea basins" because of their growing chat context, local solution regions they can't escape. Their "Fork-and-Flush" method clears the chat history but keeps the workspace, achieving up to 66 percent better results on the same compute budget. The article Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions appeared first on The Decoder .

title: Microsoft plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027
summary_raw: Microsoft will make its in-house Azure Maia chips the main AI inference system across its products starting in 2027, deploying them at multi-gigawatt scale. The upcoming Maia 300 should deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems. CEO Satya Nadella calls it "our biggest bet yet on our own silicon." title: White House reverses course and restores UK AI Safety Institute's access to frontier models
summary_raw: The White House has reversed course and restored the UK's AI Security Institute's early access to AI models from Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and OpenAI. title: Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy says "the external world has seen the preview" of what AI can actually do
summary_raw: Andrej Karpathy, co-founder of OpenAI and now at Anthropic, sees a widening knowledge gap in AI.
